title: Protect banking credentials
content: Never share your banking password, PIN, OTP, CVV or UPI PIN with anyone. Register your mobile number and email with your bank to receive transaction alerts. Use verified and trusted websites for online banking.
supported_topics: banking security; PIN; OTP; passwords; transaction alerts

title: Lost or stolen payment card
content: If an ATM card, debit card, credit card or prepaid card is lost or stolen, block the card immediately.
supported_topics: lost card; stolen card; compromised card

title: Avoid suspicious banking links
content: Do not share passwords, PINs, OTPs or CVVs over phone or online. Do not click suspicious links received through SMS, email or social media.

title: Recognise digital payment fraud
content: Be cautious of fake cashback links, QR codes from unknown people, unknown applications, fake investment schemes and messages designed to deceive payment users. Scanning a QR code and entering a UPI PIN is for making a payment, not for receiving money.
supported_topics: UPI; QR codes; cashback scams; payment fraud

title: Synthetic test: refund status
content: This is synthetic test content, not a real banking policy. A customer asks about a missing refund. The system should explain that refund timing depends on the merchant and payment provider and direct the customer to the relevant merchant or provider for transaction-specific status.

title: Synthetic test: unsupported bank-specific fee
content: This is a synthetic fallback test, not a real banking policy. It does not establish any actual bank's fees, charges or transaction limits. If a customer asks for an unsupported bank-specific fee, the system should request the bank name or refer the customer to the bank's official fee schedule.

title: Failed UPI transaction and refund guidance
content: If a UPI transaction fails and the payer's bank account is debited, the amount should be refunded. NPCI advises contacting the bank if the refund is not received within one hour. Customers should check the transaction status and follow the applicable grievance process.
supported_topics: UPI; failed transaction; account debited; refund; transaction status; complaint

title: Reversal timelines for failed payment transactions
content: RBI specifies reversal timelines for particular failed payment scenarios. For a UPI funds transfer where the payer is debited but the beneficiary is not credited, the specified auto-reversal timeline is T+1 day. For a merchant payment where the account is debited but confirmation is not received at the merchant location, the specified timeline is T+5 days. The applicable timeline depends on the transaction type.
supported_topics: failed transaction; UPI reversal; T+1; T+5; merchant payment; reversal timeline

title: Reporting unauthorized electronic banking transactions
content: Customers should report unauthorized electronic banking transactions to their bank immediately after noticing them. Banks must provide channels for reporting these transactions and take steps to prevent further unauthorized transactions after receiving a report. Customer liability depends on the circumstances and applicable RBI rules, including reporting time.
supported_topics: unauthorized transaction; electronic banking fraud; report fraud; customer liability; bank complaint
